description: Message redaction for shareable diagnostic reports. The desktop (apps/ket-desktop/src/lib/diagnostics.ts) and Android (ConnectionDiagnostics.kt) apps both replay these cases.

cases.name: plain wording is kept
cases.input: the control server could not be reached: request timed out
cases.output: the control server could not be reached: request timed out

cases.name: host names with and without ports
cases.input: TLS to vpn.example.com:443 for www.wikipedia.org failed

cases.name: bearer tokens and named secrets
cases.input: Authorization: Bearer abc.def-123 password=hunter2 session_token: zzz

cases.name: versions, durations, and codes are kept
cases.input: Ket 1.2.0 timed out after 15s (code transport_failed, HTTP 504)
cases.output: Ket 1.2.0 timed out after 15s (code transport_failed, HTTP 504)
